changelog: Aura AI v2.0.2 Home Screen Redesign & Polish
Premium Home Screen UI: Minimal slim floating pill input bar (52-56dp) with 36dp circular buttons (+, Waveform, Mic/Send) and 48dp touch targets
Full-width text field with complete, non-truncated 'Ask anything...' placeholder
